caption: The anchor rope of a small boat is hauled in, and the rope comes up taut and dripping until the anchor breaks the surface.

sa.check: An anchor rope runs from a small boat into the water.
The rope comes up taut and dripping.
The hauling comes first and the anchor appears last.

pc.expect: The rope runs straight down under load and stays taut while pulled.
pc.fail: It is slack while hauling; or stretches; or hangs in a loose curve.

pc.expect: Water drips downward from the rope and the anchor hangs below it.
pc.fail: Drips rise; or the anchor is above the rope; or the rope rises on its own.

pc.expect: The anchor appears only when enough rope is in.
pc.fail: It appears immediately; or the rope is hauled and no anchor comes; or it appears elsewhere.

pc.expect: The rope moves only as it is hauled.
pc.fail: It climbs by itself; or the anchor rises alone; or the boat shoots away.

pc.expect: One rope and one anchor keep their number.
pc.fail: The rope splits; or the anchor duplicates; or the anchor vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The boat and the water stay the same.
pc.fail: The boat changes colour; or the water changes; or the shore rearranges.
